parsed.answer: For YouTube, the parent relationships are: immediate parent is Google LLC, top parent is Alphabet Inc., and top operating parent is Google LLC. The immediate parent and top operating parent match because Google LLC is already the highest operating company beneath the holding company Alphabet.

chunks.b0ff7639b1d9:
Alphabet is a holding company, so the top operating parent stops at Google LLC, the highest operating company, while the top parent continues to the top of the tree.

For YouTube:

Relationship: Account; Entity: YouTube.
Relationship: Immediate parent; Entity: Google LLC.
Relationship: Top parent; Entity: Alphabet Inc..
Relationship: Top operating parent; Entity: Google LLC.

Here the immediate parent and the top operating parent match, because Google is already the highest operating company beneath the holding company. That is not always the case. When an account sits under a mid-tier operating company, the immediate parent and the top operating parent differ:

There is no holding company to skip, so the top operating parent equals the top parent (Microsoft). The immediate parent is the mid-tier operating company, Activision Blizzard.

For Blizzard Entertainment:

Relationship: Account; Entity: Blizzard Entertainment.
Relationship: Immediate parent; Entity: Activision Blizzard.
Relationship: Top parent; Entity: Microsoft.
Relationship: Top operating parent; Entity: Microsoft.
